name: SuperFun
desc: SuperFun — a whole arcade of little e-ink games in one plugin: Sudoku, Nonogram, Minesweeper, Word Search, 2048, 15-Puzzle, Mastermind, Peg Solitaire, Memory, Tic-Tac-Toe, Ultimate TTT, Connect Four, Reversi, Checkers, Dames, Dots & Boxes, Pig, Snakes & Ladders and Battleship. Play solo, against the Supernote, or with 2–4 players — with saved games and a records board.
